By utilizing COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can launch your digital storefront without the constraints of traditional payment platforms.

content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional payment platforms often impose high fees and geographical restrictions, preventing digital creators from accessing global markets. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, which can significantly cut into your earnings. In contrast, using NOWPayments, you only incur a 0.5% fee. This difference means that for 100 sales of a $97 product, you retain $921 more. This is the power of infrastructure sovereignty: you own your digital ecosystem, free from external constraints.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can begin selling your digital products, gather the necessary tools and resources. You'll need a domain name for branding and hosting, which can be done for free using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Additionally, familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment processing. Collect and prepare your digital products, such as ebooks or courses, ensuring they are ready for upload and immediate delivery.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To build your payment and delivery pipeline, start by integrating NOWPayments with your chosen hosting service. You will write a script using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle order verification and product delivery. This script will automatically send digital products to customers once payment is confirmed on-chain, minimizing delays. Ensure you have set up a secure order storage method, such as Supabase or Google Sheets, to track sales and customer data.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, saving you money on transactions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your infrastructure in place, it's time to go live. Publish your digital storefront and test your payment processing by making a small transaction. Monitor the system to ensure that orders are being processed correctly and that customers receive their products immediately. Adjust any settings as necessary based on your testing. Once everything is functioning seamlessly, begin promoting your store through social media and online communities.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, utilize a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments integrated into your own website. By using COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can automate sales and product delivery while keeping costs low. This setup allows you to receive payments in multiple cryptocurrencies, ensuring access to a global market.
You own your digital storefront — no subscriptions, no dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell an ebook without using PayPal or Stripe?
Use a platform like NOWPayments to process crypto payments. Integrate this with your website to facilitate sales directly. This approach allows you to bypass traditional payment methods entirely.
What are the fees associated with selling digital downloads?
Platforms like Gumroad charge 10% on each sale, which can add up quickly. In contrast, NOWPayments only charges a 0.5% fee, maximizing your earnings and minimizing costs.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by creating your own digital storefront using the COREMERCH infrastructure. This allows complete control over your sales and fees.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, giving you the flexibility to accept various digital currencies for your sales.
How do I ensure my customers get their products immediately?
Integrate your payment system with automated delivery through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. This ensures that once payment confirms, customers receive their products instantly.
